notes.title: Patch 10.2
notes.content:
We’re excited to roll out the next step of our roadmap — patch 10.2! 
The comprehensive map updates continue, and we’re bringing significant changes to the second location this time.

Complete Rework of the Second Map
We’ve redesigned the map to make your flights more dynamic and realistic. 
What’s new: 
• Fresh visuals and atmosphere — the map now features updated models and textures for a more immersive experience. 
• Improved gameplay logic — interference inside buildings and trenches has increased slightly, adding extra challenge and realism to your flights. 
• New anti-drone net area — a small but strategically important zone that affects your routes and tactical decisions.

Optimization
Alongside the visual updates, we keep working on performance. You can expect smooth and stable flights with every upgrade.
This is another step forward in evolving FPV Battleground. More map updates and new features are on the way!

Thank you for your support and feedback — share your impressions of the reworked second map in discussions. Together, we’re making FPV Battleground even better!

notes.title: Patch 10.1
notes.content:
Hello, pilots!
We are happy to present the first update according to our roadmap and patch 10.1! As promised, we are starting a series of comprehensive updates for all existing maps, and today we are taking the first big step in this direction.

Global overhaul of the first map

The starting location where everything began has been given a new lease on life. We didn't just change a few details—we reimagined it from scratch to make your flights even more exciting.
What's new:
• Completely new visuals and models: The map has been given a radical new look. We replaced the old assets with new 3D models and more modern textures, which significantly increased the realism and atmosphere of the location.
• Expanded territory: The game world has become bigger! We have expanded the map's boundaries, adding new areas for exploration, training, and tactical maneuvers.
• Well-thought-out environment logic: We have redesigned the map, making it more logical. The new layout of objects creates interesting routes and challenges for both beginners and experienced pilots.

Optimization and performance boost (FPS BOOST)

More beautiful doesn't mean slower! Along with the visual update, we have carried out extensive optimization work. The result is an increase in FPS on the updated map. Your flights will not only be more spectacular, but also much smoother.
This is just the first step on the road to significant changes. We are continuing to work on other maps and game features.
Thank you for your incredible support! Share your impressions of the updated map in the discussions. Together, we are making FPV Battleground better!

notes.title: Patch 9.0
notes.content:
Hello, pilots! We are pleased to present a fresh update on the FPV Battleground.

New mission and air combat:


 New map with aerial targets. A new location has been added where your primary targets will move aerial threats. Now every decision and every maneuver matters!
 

 A new drone model has been developed for this mission, ideally suited for intercepting and destroying targets in the air.


Improvements to the interface and gaming experience:


 Updated mission selection interface: We have redesigned the screen to make it more intuitive and informative.


 A realistic visual noise/interference system has been added, which significantly enhances the immersion effect and adds challenge when flying at the edge of the radio horizon.


Map and environment updates:


 The factory area on the second map has been significantly redesigned and improved—new objects, cover, and updated details open up fresh tactical opportunities.


 We continue to improve the game's visual component by updating several 3D models for greater realism. 


We appreciate your support and feedback! Your activity helps us make FPV Battleground even more realistic and exciting. Leave your suggestions - together we can reach new heights!

notes.title: Patch 8.0
notes.content:
This update improves the game's functionality and fixes key bugs, providing even more enjoyment from the game: 
Map and environment updates:

  Updated the architecture of multi-story buildings for more realistic and tactical gameplay.
  Redesigned residential buildings with improved detail.
  Updated lighting system for better atmosphere and visual perception.

New mechanics and gameplay:

  Added the ability to destroy buildings, opening up new tactical approaches and strategies.
  Revised explosion radius and charge impact for a more realistic experience.
  Added a fan mission as a precursor to a new mission in the next patch.

Realism and physics improvements:
 
 Adjusted drone speed based on benchmarks from a real drone for maximum realism.
  Improved flight mechanics for smoother and more responsive control.
  Updated radio horizon coefficients for greater realism.

Tactical updates:

 Vehicles now spawn in random locations for more unpredictable gameplay.
 Snipers have been added to strategic positions in buildings to increase difficulty and realism. (Look for the marker on the compass.)

We appreciate your support and feedback! Your activity helps us make FPV Battleground even more realistic and exciting. Leave your suggestions - together, we can reach new heights!

notes.title: Patch 7.0
notes.content:

New content: 

 
 Added the ability to change the drone's configuration and create your own build. 
 Saving your own configuration presets - easily switch between your favorite settings. 
 Added configurations for 7-inch and 10-inch drones.


   Physics and control: 
 
 Improved flight physics - even more realistic and smooth. 
 Updated control system - flexibility and control are even better. 


   Interface updates: 
 
 Updated projectile selection interface for a new look and improved usability. 


Fixes and improvements: 

 Improved localization - updated texts and fixed translation errors. 


General optimizations - more stable gameplay. 

Thank you for your support!   Your feedback is the best compass in the development of FPV Battleground. Keep sharing your ideas, and we will improve the game together with you!

notes.title: Patch 4.0
notes.content:
This update opens up new tactical planning options and improves terrain orientation for an even more strategic and immersive gaming experience!

New functionality:
Pre-mission map - now you can view the map with marked objectives before you start.
Custom points on the map - players can set their own marks for better orientation.
Map during the mission - the ability to open the map at any time during the mission to view the situation.
Elevation chart - added the ability to build an elevation chart with a line of sight display.
Elevation slice - a new feature for detailed terrain analysis and tactical planning.

Improvements and fixes:
Updated and improved localization for all supported languages - the text is more accurate and natural.
Fixed a number of bugs to improve the overall stability of the game.

Thank you for your support and feedback! Your feedback helps us to improve FPV Battleground. Keep sharing your ideas - together we make the game even better!

notes.title: Patch 3.0
notes.content:
This update introduces new customization options, enhances physics and visuals, and improves game stability for a more immersive experience.

Settings
- You can now adjust the layout of on-screen display (OSD) elements to tailor the interface to your playstyle.
- Added the ability to select weather conditions (such as snow, rain, and wind) to create unique mission scenarios.
- Introduced a function to reset settings to default parameters.

Gameplay
- Enhanced battery physics for more realistic drone control.
- Battery drain and flight speed now depend on the type of projectiles used, adding strategic depth to the gameplay.

Graphics
- Projectiles have been completely redrawn to be more detailed and realistic.
- Smoke animation has been updated for a more natural appearance.
- Truck combustion animation has been revised for more dynamic effects.

Stability
- Improved translations for all supported languages, making the text more accurate and natural.
- Fixed several bugs to enhance overall game stability.

Thank you for your support and feedback! Your input helps us improve the FPV Battleground. Keep sharing your ideas—together we can make the game even better!

notes.title: Patch 2.0
notes.content:
This update improves the game's functionality and fixes key bugs, providing even more fun to play:

-   UI fixes:
  - Fixed an issue with the scrollbar in the language selection menu that caused scrolling to a space.
  - Now, the text of the mission results corresponds to the game's selected language.
  - The cursor is no longer visible during flight, which improves the gameplay.

- Improvements to statistics and modes:
  - Added mission time to the statistics, allowing you to analyze your results more accurately.
  - A visual effect was added when leaving the zone.

- Gameplay updates:
  - Fixed a bug where the drone could flip over and not explode. Now, the drone works as expected.
  - Adjusted the display of the target table in training mode.
  - Added the ability to change projectiles between flights for a more flexible strategy.

- Graphics and customization:
  - Updated the horizon line's functionality, improving flight orientation.
  - A field of view (FOV) setting was added to customize the game environment.

- Localization:
  - Updated translations to provide more accurate and understandable text for different languages.

We appreciate your support and feedback! Your activity helps us to make FPV Battleground even more realistic and exciting. Keep leaving your suggestions - together, we reach new heights!

notes.title: Patch 1.0
notes.content:
This update introduces new features and resolves important issues to enhance your gaming experience: 

- Customizable Controls: Players can now personalize button and axis settings to suit their preferences. 
- Saved Settings: Your settings will now be securely saved, ensuring they remain intact even after completing missions or exiting the game. 
- Fixed Infantry Bug: We've resolved a bug that allowed destroyed infantry to continue shooting, eliminating unexpected attacks from eliminated enemies. 
- Enhanced Target Hit Bar: The font for the target hit bar has been updated for improved clarity and readability. 

Additionally, numerous minor fixes have been implemented to enhance game stability and overall performance. 

Thank you for your support and feedback! Together, we are making FPV Battleground even better.
